title: Tour purchase quotes
summary: List, a quote's details (totals, invoiced, collected and statuses), its actions and tabs.

steps.title: Menu → Purchases → Purchase Quotes
steps.details: A provider's quote: which products or services, at what price. Once confirmed, it's invoiced when received.

steps.title: Search
steps.details: By quote number or provider name.

steps.title: Export
steps.details: Downloads the list to Excel or CSV.

steps.title: Row actions
steps.details: Print, email and, for drafts, edit, confirm, reject or delete, without opening the details.

steps.title: Open a quote
steps.details: Tap one to see its details.

steps.title: Summary
steps.details: Total, invoiced, pending invoicing, collected and pending collection, and the quote, invoicing and payment statuses.

steps.title: Actions
steps.details: Draft: edit, confirm, reject or delete. Always: print and email. Confirmed with a balance: invoice.

steps.title: Items
steps.details: The quote's services or products with quantity and price.

steps.title: Invoices
steps.details: The invoices generated from this quote.

steps.title: Payments
steps.details: What was paid on those invoices.
